output.brief: The rejects are not caused by the new operators or by Arnholt resin on its own. They come from Arnholt resin being dried in dryer D5, which has been drifting wet (about -16 °C dew point instead of -40 °C). In week 42, the same Arnholt lot gave 10.4% rejects through D5 but 0.8% when dried in a portable dryer and fed to Press 5. Press 7, which uses D7, runs Arnholt at 0.8%. Experienced operators show the same reject rate as the new hires, so putting the six on improvement plans would not fix anything and would be unfair to them. Do this week: repair D5's heater and desiccant, confirm dew point is back to -40 °C, and restore the original alarm limit. Until then, keep Arnholt off D5 and add a moisture check at the press throat for each VX lot. Do not drop Arnholt yet. Open question: all Arnholt is stored in the unconditioned annex, which may add moisture; test that before spending on storage changes. Confidence is good but not complete.
output.methodChoice: Kepner-Tregoe problem and decision analysis, using two collected items (X15, X12)
